items.source: Micron Form 8-K, Q4 FY26 press release
notes: Core Data Center is the swing factor: $18.0B, up 1,041% Y/Y, now a third of revenue.
Cost of revenue is only $7.2B of $54.2B — an 87% gross margin, extraordinary for a memory maker and the clearest sign of where pricing sits in this cycle.
Operating expenses total $3.3B, just 6% of revenue, so almost all gross profit drops to operating profit.
Full fiscal year 2026: $133.19B revenue and $84.97B net income. Q1 FY27 guidance is ~$61.5B ± $1.5B.
